translations.web: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
translations.bsb: God will judge those outside. “Expel the wicked man from among you.”
translations.kjv: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
translations.asv: But them that are without God judgeth. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.
